sections.heading: Purpose
sections.text: This prepared scenario demonstrates claim traceability. All conditions, measurements, passages, and reference markers below are synthetic and make no claim about real research.

sections.heading: Illustrative result
sections.text: In the synthetic example dataset, Condition A is associated with a 10% increase in Outcome B. The prepared evidence describes only this outcome and does not establish effects across other outcomes or populations.

sections.heading: Illustrative limitation
sections.text: The scenario does not provide enough information about sample size, methods, or population coverage to support a universal conclusion.

sections.heading: Illustrative time context
sections.text: A fictional scenario baseline is labeled 2011. The fixture contains no real publication date or current comparison.
